Fresh independent generation of the paperfolding prefix through 5P, for all 31 thresholds, explicitly found a predecessor collision and injectivity at each threshold with the one-count condition and correct 4n factor counts: 62 decisive lengths. These finite exhaustive certificates together with the covering/inheritance proofs establish all n, not a finite extrapolation.
